first_return_goal_deshift_minus_intact.scope: First return only; first discovery before decision1050 leaves300 decisions. Endpoint=min(actual return time,20seconds). All eligible episodes retained, including failed returns. Time components sum exactly to capped duration. Protocol addition made after first two descriptive phase seeds, before inspecting first-return endpoints.

statistics: Paired training-seed contrasts; 12 exploratory comparisons per contrast family. Holm t and exact sign-flip separately. Five matched-complete-trip contrasts form separate exploratory families. Conditional successful-trip quantities are not unconditional policy effects.
limitations: Native models visit different states; phase-conditioned changes need not identify the causal mediator.
Matched trip comparisons require both controllers to finish that ordinal return; censoring may select easier trips.
Near threshold .6m chosen before inspecting traces, twice actual goal radius .3m. All raw step exposures and failed/censored return attempts retained.

action_strategy.scope: Exploratory characterization of sampled native-policy actions after first discovery. Preferred turn and translation chosen from observed frequencies; action-index conventions follow code/env.py. Native-controller hybrids can change preferred movement axis or turn direction.
